items.title: Youth-Led Inclusion Storytelling
items.description:
Advance disability inclusion in South Africa and shift the disability narrative through community-led, youth-led storytelling.. Runs youth-led inclusion storytelling and verifies proposal, publication and engagement claims denominated in Verified Inclusion Story Units (VISU); also designs and fits assistive devices and runs Let us Talk Disability dialogues.. Disability-inclusion ecosystem partner / credential issuer

  • Storytelling
  • Digital Storytelling
  • Media Production
  • Content Creation
  • Advocacy
items.summary: Got a story that could change how people see disability? If you're 18–35 and live with a disability, create a media piece — video, audio, art or writing — and share it with the world. Four simple steps: sign up, pitch your idea, share your story, then reflect on the impact you made. Your voice, your story, real change.

items.title: The Dignity Project
items.description:
Restore dignity in Vrygrond, Cape Town — clean streets, dignified income for unemployed youth, and waste diverted from landfill — through a community-led, DAO-anchored dignity economy.. Registers and credentials youth Dignity Agents (onboarding, Web3 literacy, role responsibility) and verifies their bin-delivery, street-cleaning, waste-sorting and bin-return claims — triggering prepaid-card payouts and issuing Verified Dignity Units (VDU), one per household-month of bundled service.. DAO-anchored project / impact-credit issuer

  • Waste Management
  • Recycling
  • Web 3.0
  • Blockchain
items.summary: Join The Dignity Project in Vrygrond, Cape Town! Become a Dignity Agent: learn the ropes, pick up Web3 basics, and get paid on a prepaid card for real work in your community — delivering bins, cleaning, sorting waste and returning bins. Every approved task pays out automatically. Clean streets, real income, your dignity.

items.title: Learning
items.description:
A learning domain offered by LearningLLC, used to prove the claim, evaluation and credential-issuance path on IXO testnet before anything runs for real.. Hosts one claim protocol and one claim collection whose survey asks a single question - have you completed the learning? - and mirrors the resulting opportunity to yoma.world.. Test learning issuer

  • Learning Management
items.summary: A one-question learning opportunity. Complete the learning, confirm you have finished, and once your claim is approved the credential is issued. This is a test listing offered by LearningLLC to prove the Yoma credential flow end to end — it is not a real course and carries no reward.
